channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Compare how India's media, left, centre and right, covers each story, side by side.

item.title: Drug Deaths Rise in Scotland Amid Opioid Concerns
item.description: Drug-related deaths in Scotland saw an 11% increase last year, according to new data. This rise is partly attributed to the presence of nitazenes, a new form of powerful synthetic opioid, in the illicit drug market. Concerns have been… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Second man executed for 2005 Texas triple homicide
item.description: Ker’Sean Ramey, 41, was executed by lethal injection in Texas on Tuesday, a week after another man convicted in the same 2005 triple homicide was put to death. The killings occurred at a home in Texas. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US News Outlets Sue Trump Administration Over White House Ban
item.description: The US Department of Justice has defended President Donald Trump's decision to ban CNN, Politico, and MS Now from the White House. The news organizations had sued the administration, claiming the ban violates the First Amendment. The… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Alleges $20 Billion H-1B Visa Fraud, Warns of Action
item.description: The Trump administration has alleged a $20 billion fraud related to H-1B visas, citing foreign labor fraud and warning that "handcuffs are coming." Separately, the administration is reported to have dropped 760,000 Americans from ACA… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Two More Arrested in SSC GD Constable Exam Irregularities
item.description: Two more individuals have been arrested in connection with irregularities in the SSC GD Constable Exam 2026. Among those arrested is the director of the company responsible for selecting exam centers. The main accused in the hacking of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Delhi court grants bail to 6 Ukrainians in drone training case
item.description: A Delhi court has granted default bail to six Ukrainian nationals who were allegedly involved in a drone training camp in Myanmar. The individuals were reportedly detained in India. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court Overturns Patna High Court Order on 'Rape Attempt'
item.description: The Supreme Court on Tuesday expressed strong displeasure with a Patna High Court order that stated removing a salwar was not an attempt to rape. Chief Justice of India (CJI) Justice Surya Kant, while hearing the case, remarked that the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: ED Raids Nephew of Punjab Minister in GMADA Land Scam
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) conducted raids at 26 locations across Panchkula and Ludhiana, including the residence of Anmol, the nephew of Punjab Cabinet Minister Hardeep Singh Mundian. The raids are reportedly linked to the GMADA… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Nainital water contamination: Six engineers suspended after two deaths
item.description: In Nainital, six engineers have been suspended following the contamination of the water supply, which has been linked to the deaths of two people. Chief Minister Dhami has stated that action has been taken. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Four Killed, One Injured in Haryana Road Accidents
item.description: Four people, including a man and three children from the same family, died in separate road accidents in Haryana's Nuh district and West Champaran. In Nuh, a speeding truck hit a motorcycle late Tuesday night near Maria Manzil School on… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Youth Shot Dead Amidst Renewed Violence in Manipur
item.description: A 17-year-old Naga boy was shot dead in the Tamenglong district of Manipur. Another man was shot dead in the Kangpokpi district of Manipur, where six individuals were subsequently arrested, leading to fresh tensions. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Bombay High Court Rules Duty-Free Shops Subject to Indian Laws
item.description: The Bombay High Court has rejected a plea by Gautam Adani's entity that duty-free shops located in international departure areas are beyond the reach of domestic laws. The court ruled that these shops must comply with Indian regulations… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Kills Four, Including Wife and Priests, Then Killed in Encounter
item.description: In Azamgarh, Uttar Pradesh, a man identified as Arvind Singh allegedly opened fire during a puja ceremony, killing his wife and two priests. The incident stemmed from a dispute that began in 2019 when Arvind's brother was murdered… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Security Guard Arrested for Alleged Molestation in Hyderabad
item.description: A security guard has been arrested in Hyderabad in connection with the alleged molestation of a software engineer. The incident occurred in Gachibowli. The woman filed a complaint with the police, who registered a case and reviewed CCTV… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Sikkim Rapper UNB Attacked in Arunachal Pradesh
item.description: Sikkim-based rapper Ugen Namgyal Bhutia, known as UNB, was allegedly attacked by a group of men in the Lower Dibang Valley district of Arunachal Pradesh. Police confirmed the incident on Wednesday. The attack reportedly occurred while the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court takes note of Rajasthan ranger's killing amid illegal mining
item.description: The Supreme Court has taken note of the killing of forest ranger Pratap Singh Chundawat in Rajasthan, an incident linked to illegal mining. The court is seeking a response from the state government and has suggested that preventive… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Dismisses PIL on Social Media Content Removal
item.description: The Supreme Court of India has rejected a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) that sought the removal of social media content deemed to be causing communal disharmony, threatening national integrity, or undermining the judiciary. Chief… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: LSR College Shifts to Online Classes After Gangrape Near Campus
item.description: Lady Shri Ram College (LSR) in Delhi has suspended offline classes and moved to online teaching following an alleged gangrape of a 17-year-old girl in Aastha Kunj Park near Kalkaji Mandir. The decision was made due to heightened safety… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 9 · Right 0.

item.title: Attorney Seeks Juror Investigation in Lindsay Clancy Murder Trial
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's attorney has requested a judge investigate a lone juror who reportedly favored conviction. Patrick Clancy, Lindsay Clancy's husband, described experiencing a "massive" panic attack during the murder trial. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Weinstein faces resentencing for 2006 sex assault in New York
item.description: Harvey Weinstein is scheduled for resentencing in New York for a 2006 sex assault. The specific date for the resentencing was not provided in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Journalist Ravi Nair Denied Bail in Adani Defamation Case
item.description: The Gujarat High Court has refused to release journalist Ravi Nair from custody in a defamation case filed by the Adani Group. Nair has been imprisoned in connection with this case. Concerns have been raised regarding his continued… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court hears Noida DM's plea, reserves order
item.description: The Supreme Court heard a plea by Noida District Magistrate (DM) Medha Roopam challenging an Allahabad High Court order. During the hearing, the audio feed was muted. The Allahabad High Court had ordered the recovery of ₹5 lakh from Medha… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 3.

item.title: Worker Dies in Fall at Rome's Colosseum
item.description: A 22-year-old rope access worker died after falling approximately 10 meters (32 feet) while installing lights inside Rome's Colosseum. The incident occurred on Wednesday, leading to the closure of the ancient Roman amphitheater for the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Cargo Ship Struck by Projectile in Strait of Hormuz; Two Casualties
item.description: A cargo vessel was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in two casualties. The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported the incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: ICC Convicts Central African Republic Rebel Leader of Crimes Against Humanity
item.description: The International Criminal Court (ICC) convicted Mahamat Said Abdel Kani, a former militia commander from the Central African Republic, on Wednesday for crimes against humanity. Said was found guilty of torture and unlawful imprisonment… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Mumbai Crime Branch Probes IIT Bombay Student's Death
item.description: The Mumbai Crime Branch has taken over the investigation into the death of an IIT Bombay student. Sources indicate the student, identified as Sahil, spoke to a friend hours before his death, admitting he had "made a mistake." A 10-member… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 7 · Right 2.

item.title: Victoria's Big Build Royal Commission Holds First Public Hearing
item.description: Victoria's Royal Commission into the state's $150 billion Big Build infrastructure projects has commenced its first public hearing. The inquiry is investigating allegations of corruption and criminal conduct within the project. The… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: KTR asks Supreme Court to monitor Election Commission probe
item.description: Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS) working president K. T. Rama Rao has urged the Supreme Court to take suo motu cognizance of concerns regarding the functioning of the Election Commission of India (ECI). Rao stated that the ECI is facing a… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Uttarakhand Revenue Officers Suspended in Fake MBBS Admissions Case
item.description: Two revenue sub-inspectors in Uttarakhand, Jagdish Rathore and Dimple, have been suspended following a preliminary inquiry into a case involving fake MBBS admissions. The case reportedly concerns the use of fraudulent freedom fighter… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Maharashtra FDA Chief Warns Celebs on Product Endorsements
item.description: Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe has issued a reminder to celebrities regarding their responsibility when endorsing food products. Mundhe stated that influence should not be equated with immunity… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Congress Challenges BJP Candidate's Age in Nandigram Bypoll
item.description: The Congress has filed a petition in the Calcutta High Court challenging the age of Hasirani Rath, the BJP's candidate for the Nandigram Assembly bypoll. The party alleges discrepancies in the electoral affidavit submitted by Rath… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Police report rise in vape spiking cases
item.description: Police in London have reported a rise in cases of vape spiking, particularly at house parties. Sky News issued a warning regarding vape spiking following the police report. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Mass shooting at South African house party kills 11, injures 3
item.description: Police said three gunmen entered a house party in KwaMakhutha township, about 30 km south of Durban, forced victims into a single room and opened fire, killing 11 people-including a woman believed to be pregnant-and wounding three. Two… Coverage: Left 5 · Centre 14 · Right 3.

item.title: Nithari Killings Accused Surendra Koli Dies
item.description: Surendra Koli, an accused in the Nithari killings case, has died. An autopsy report stated he died of asphyxia. One report indicated he died by suicide, and that he had been acquitted in the Nithari killings case. Koli was known by the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Texas Rangers investigate Camp Mystic flood deaths for manslaughter
item.description: The Texas Rangers have launched a criminal investigation into the deaths of 27 girls at Camp Mystic during devastating flooding last year. Investigators are seeking evidence that could lead to charges of manslaughter or negligent homicide… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Israeli soldier accused of war crimes leaves India after complaint
item.description: An Israeli soldier, accused of war crimes and acts of genocide in Gaza, has left India. This departure occurred weeks after the Hind Rajab Foundation (HRF), identified as a Palestinian rights group, filed a criminal complaint against him… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Adani Firms Settle SEBI Cases for Rs 1.5 Crore
item.description: Five Adani Group firms have settled Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) cases related to the Hindenburg report by paying a total of Rs 1.5 crore. The SEBI has closed these proceedings against the companies. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Telangana HRC Seeks Report on Alleged Torture of Elderly Woman
item.description: The Telangana Human Rights Commission (HRC) has requested a report from the collector concerning the alleged torture of an elderly woman. The alleged torture is reportedly linked to superstition. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Army Jawan Killed in Mizoram Road Rage Incident
item.description: An Army jawan, identified as returning home on vacation, was killed in a road rage incident in Mizoram. Six individuals have been arrested in connection with the killing. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: India's Election Commission Systems Under Scrutiny Over Voter Rolls
item.description: India's Election Commission's voter software systems, ECINet and ERONET, are under scrutiny following reports of a rift concerning voter rolls. The systems are central to the current row, with discussions focusing on their functionality… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.
